method: Agent visual self-score from all 12 cat and 13 enemy five-frame sheets. Five frozen samples inform motion; continuous motion acceptance is separate. Configured layers are not perceived layers. 48 cat active skills include 12 ultimates; 12 passive presentations give 60 distinct cat tiles, plus 26 enemy cues.
